name: Congregational Advocate (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
body:
Adventuring can be a messy business. Often, a company of adventurers will break laws, taboos, and the occasional skull in their pursuit of fame and glory. To safeguard themselves from these unfortunate eventualities, an adventuring party will enlist a congregational advocate into their ranks. These specialized inquisitors are trained not only for adventure but keeping adventurers out of trouble.

Cunning Speaker (Ex)

Starting at 2nd level, a congregational advocate receives a circumstance bonus on Bluff checks to lie and on Diplomacy checks to influence the attitude of creatures equal to 1/2 her inquisitor level (minimum +1).

This replaces cunning initiative.

Exodus (Ex)

At 2nd level, a congregational advocate can make it more difficult to track down herself and a number of creatures equal to her Wisdom bonus. The difficulty of tracking her and her congregation increases by 1/2 her inquisitor level (minimum +1).

This replaces track.

Rabble Control (Sp)

At 5th level, a congregational advocate can use mass charm person, as per the spell, for a number of rounds per day equal to her inquisitor level. These rounds do not need to be consecutive. Activating this ability is an immediate action.

This replaces discern lies.
